wins.text: Q2 revenue of $30B, up 122% YoY and 15% sequentially, well above $28B guidance
Data Center revenue of $26.3B, a record, up 154% YoY and 16% sequentially, driven by Hopper GPU and networking demand
Non-GAAP gross margins of 75.7%; cash flow from operations of $14.5B in Q2
Ethernet for AI (Spectrum-X) revenue doubled sequentially with hundreds of customers; on track to be a multibillion-dollar product line within a year
Board approved new $50B share repurchase authorization on top of remaining $7.5B; $7.4B returned to shareholders in Q2 via buybacks and dividends

risks.text: Blackwell GPU mask change required to improve production yields; Blackwell production ramp delayed to Q4, with only 'several billion dollars' of revenue expected in Q4

GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins guided lower sequentially to 74.4%/75.0% in Q3, with further pressure expected in Q4 due to new product mix shifts and inventory provisions for low-yielding Blackwell material
China Data Center revenue remains below pre-export-control levels as a percentage of total; market expected to remain 'very competitive' going forward
Demand for Blackwell platforms is well above supply and expected to remain constrained into next year, creating potential fulfillment risk
Full-year operating expenses expected to grow in the mid- to upper 40% range, reflecting significant R&D investment in next-generation products

guidance_items.detail: Q3 revenue guided to $32.5B +/- 2%, above Q2 actual of $30B and prior $28B guide; Q4 expected to grow further with Blackwell ramp adding several billion dollars
Q3 non-GAAP gross margin guided to ~75% (+/- 50 bps), down from Q2's 75.7%; full-year expected in mid-70% range with further Q4 pressure from new product mix
Software/SaaS/support revenue expected to approach $2B annual run rate exiting fiscal 2025; sovereign AI revenue expected to reach low double-digit billions for the full year
Full-year operating expenses expected to grow mid- to upper 40% range, reflecting accelerated investment in next-generation product development

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Customer/hyperscaler ROI on CapEx and sustainability of AI infrastructure spending
Geographic revenue mix shift (U.S. down sequentially, Asian geographies up sharply per 10-Q)
Liquid cooling readiness among customers as a potential gating factor for Blackwell rack-scale ramp
